details:
Q1. What is the primary target of this issue? Pick one.
Choices:
A. Clarify/plan/implement workflow or prompt behavior
B. Review/autofix/orchestrator/validate behavior
C. Docs/templates/configuration only
D. Another specific file/path/workflow not listed above — name it exactly (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What specific improvement do you want in that target area? Pick one.
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug/regression — describe the current wrong behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability/performance of an existing behavior — name the current failure mode or bottleneck
C. Add or change behavior — describe the exact new behavior
D. Documentation/content improvement — name the exact text/section/file to update
Q3. What concrete artifact should planning use to verify the change? Choose one or more if available.
Choices:
A. The exact issue/PR/workflow run/log snippet showing the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A before/after example of the desired behavior (RECOMMENDED)
C. The exact files/paths you expect to change
D. A short acceptance checklist in plain English
